description: Precisely search current public UK caravan, motorhome and campervan stock using structured buyer filters. Supports vehicle type, make/model, condition, price, year, berths, travel seats, transmission, fuel, layout/bed type, dimensions, licence/weight, payload, mileage, features, dealer and postcode/radius. Use hard limits exactly as supplied; for fuzzy priorities and trade-offs use find_matching_vehicles. Returns at most 10 public vehicles with canonical RoamWorthy URLs, structured specs and data-quality provenance. Read-only; no private dealer/consumer data and no bulk export.

bedTypes.description: Any acceptable bed type, e.g. island bed or fixed bed.

features.description: All requested feature terms must be evidenced by structured tags/layout or public listing text.

limit.description: Maximum 10 public results; bulk export and pagination are unavailable.

maxWeightKg.description: Maximum GVW for motorhomes/campervans or MTPLM for caravans.

minTravelSeats.description: Minimum travelling seats/seatbelts; listing data first, canonical model research fallback.

postcode.description: UK postcode used only to calculate dealer distance.

query.description: Free-text keyword matched against title, make and model.

radiusMiles.description: Maximum straight-line distance from postcode; requires postcode.

standardLicenceOnly.description: For motorised vehicles, require evidence that C1 is not required.

name: search_listings
title: Search RoamWorthy live listings
